verses.english: “A fool is known by three things.

verses.pali: Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena.
verses.english: Unskillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which a fool is known.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: An astute person is known by three things.

verses.pali: Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena.
verses.english: Skillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which an astute person is known.
